t: Milwaukee M12 B6 12V 6.0Ah Li-Ion RedLithium battery provides reliable power for cordless tools. Ideal for demanding trade applications on construction sites or in workshops, where consistent performance is key. Integrated welded frame construction and shock-responsive separators prevent pack failure from excessive vibrations or drops, ensuring durability. Individual cell monitoring optimises charge and discharge cycles, extending the battery's operational lifespan. Designed for use with all Milwaukee M12 power tools.
